title.en: An Act Authorizing the Daniel Z. Romualdez Memorial School of Fisheries in Tolosa, Leyte, to Continue to Offer the Bachelor of Science in Fisheries Program

text.en: The Daniel Z. Romualdez Memorial School of Fisheries in Tolosa, Leyte, is hereby authorized to continue to offer the Bachelor of Science in Fisheries Program.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
